title: Environment-first Horus (deforestation, disasters, flora/fauna)
summary: Make deforestation, natural disasters and habitat the default view for Indonesian NGOs and local government analysts.

costs.$comment: Vercel Pro is assumed because Hobby is non-commercial only; keyless feeds cost nothing.

outcomes.metric: Analyst hours no longer spent compiling forest-loss and disaster feeds by hand
outcomes.$comment: ASSUMPTION: 4 partner organisations x 20 h/month. Replace with partner time logs.

outcomes.metric: Field response decisions taken on a disaster seen in Horus first
outcomes.$comment: ASSUMPTION: proxy value = coordination cost avoided per decision.

outcomes.metric: Forest-loss hotspots reviewed by a partner for follow-up
outcomes.$comment: ASSUMPTION: value of one desk review a partner would otherwise commission.

risks.title: GDACS / EONET / GBIF change or rate-limit their APIs
risks.mitigation: Merged feeds degrade per source; tests pin the normalizers; 24 h stale cache.

risks.title: Users act on tree-cover loss or occurrence density as if it were verified deforestation or habitat
risks.mitigation: Layer names, legend blurbs and README state the limits; PRD non-goal.

risks.title: All visitors shared one rate-limit key on Vercel
risks.mitigation: Fixed: api/gev.js keys clients by x-real-ip (docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md F-01).

conditions: Sign at least 2 partner organisations before month 3 and log their hours saved.
Promote to operate only with measured outcomes replacing the assumptions.
